desiredFields.description:
Wordroot is a dictionary that shows you where words come from.

Look up any English word and get clean definitions plus the full etymology chain — Middle English, Old English, Latin, Ancient Greek, Proto-Germanic, all the way back to Proto-Indo-European where the trail exists.

• Fast search with definitions grouped by part of speech
• Etymology chain showing each ancestor, its language, and how the word arrived (inherited, derived, or borrowed)
• A word of the day to start from
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking

Definitions and etymologies come from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
desiredFields.promotionalText: Look up any word and follow it back through Latin, Greek and Old English. The full origin chain, not just a definition.
desiredFields.whatsNew: Word lookups now credit Wiktionary properly, network problems report themselves instead of looking like an empty result, and definitions are handled more safely. A small reliability pass all round.
